note: The chrome every realm inherits: the rail, the command bar, the masthead, the account panel, the tray, and the six request states async.js owns. A realm registers its OWN states in its own file — this one is Part 0's, and it is the seed the catalogue grows from. `flags` are harness stub flags (stub.js reads fail/slow/offline/today/owner/realms/admin/category/destroy/draft/id/ids/mode/q/scope — there is no ?empty=; an empty state is reached by narrowing). ⚠️ TWO OF async.js's SIX REQUEST STATES ARE NOT REGISTERED HERE, and the reason is not that nobody tried: `refreshing` and `progress` were registered, walked, and REFUSED to appear — see docs/db-deferred-list.md. An `expect` selector is what turned that from a passing state into a question.

states.name: slow request
states.note: walked WHILE the request is still out — the skeleton and the is-slow note are the state

states.name: the door · signed out
states.note: the only surface a signed-out person reaches; it must not imply the app is open behind it

states.name: the door · not an admin
states.note: spec §10 — a stranger, a never-granted account and a revoked admin all read identically; forbidden adds ONE line

states.name: export strip open
states.note: the masthead Export strip — each scope states its OWN shape, because only some of them re-import ⚠️ THE STEP DELIBERATELY CARRIES NO `until`. One was added 2026-09-01 to fix a load race and became the race: `until` waits on its own 5000ms settle deadline while `expect` waits 45000ms for the SAME selector, so the redundant, tighter one failed first. A wait duplicated at two deadlines is worse than one wait, and the shorter number wins in exactly the conditions the longer one was raised for.

states.name: tooltip runtime
states.note: 32 data-tip hosts on Season and the runtime is delegated from the document; tooltips are content and are invisible to a screenshot

states.name: toast after an account action
states.note: the toast layer, reached the way a reader reaches it — and the state that found Copy ID acknowledging nothing at all

states.name: manifest selection bar
states.note: selecting a row mounts .selbar and sets body.has-selbar — a shell surface a realm switches on

states.name: one-way panel · tier 3
states.note: the seven irreversible ops at the foot of Season, gated on the destructive permission

states.name: reduced motion · season
states.note: PASS 5 — the media query is emulated and the page is made to confirm it applied, then what is still RUNNING is read. A source scan can see that app.css declares reduced-motion rules; only this can see whether the animation on screen is covered by them.
